remote_authorizations.operation: Provision new exclusive Supabase project; organization, region, cost and owner
Bind exclusive ref, public key digest, preview origin and independent Auth settings
Run remote migration dry-run, approve exact file hashes, then apply migrations
Deploy only named Functions and set APP_ORIGIN in the exclusive project
Promote exact candidate to canonical draft payload in a reviewed local commit
Remote import dry-run and explicit draft import, without technical approval
Grant catalog reviewer permission to a real identified authorized user
Reviewer explicitly decides each of the five ready sets through existing RPC/UI
Provision test farm/members and authorize narrow remote sync gate and preview rollout
Execute remote A/B smoke using actual test context and recorded identities
